name: YouMessage
description:
YouMessage — Conversations, Connected.

YouMessage is a modern messaging platform designed to bring people closer through simple, seamless communication.

Chat privately with friends and family, create group conversations, share photos and videos, send voice messages, and connect through voice and video calls.

With its clean, elegant design, smooth animations and intuitive experience, YouMessage makes staying connected effortless.

Your conversations. Your people. Your message.

Welcome to YouMessage.
